name: Persona Driver Ryuuki ~Onna Kaijin Gundan Daishingeki!~
original_name: ペルソナドライバー竜姫 ～女怪人軍団大進撃!～
source:
Autumn, 201X.

Reports began to surface of eerie, monstrous creatures lurking in the night streets of the city.
These were no ordinary monsters—they were the "Demonized Humans," an army created by the terrifying secret society known as White Joker.

Ryuugazaki Maki, a woman who had rejected White Joker’s horrifying demonization surgery with an unshakable sense of justice, now fought to protect humanity’s freedom and peace.
As Persona Driver Ryuuki, she continued to battle against the darkness…!

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ008807.html/]dlsite[/url]]
